_readme: Macro event calendar — edited by Claude on request in chat, or by hand. Fields: date (ISO, first/only day), end (ISO, optional for multi-day), name, cat (US Data / JP Data / FOMC / ECB / BoE / BoJ / Holiday / Other), time_local (HH:MM on the decision/release day = end or date), tz (IANA zone), approx (optional, true if the time is not fixed), time (human label in native tz), notes. The tab computes the UK time from time_local+tz per event date, so BST/GMT and US DST transitions are handled. Market holidays (NYSE/LSE/SIFMA) seeded through Dec 2027.
